_source: Common purification/detection tags and protease sites (curated)

His-Tag (6x).note: Purification via Immobilized Metal Affinity Chromatography (IMAC).

His-Tag (8x–10x).note: Longer His-tags for stronger binding to IMAC resins.

3xFLAG.note: Tandem tag for higher affinity detection and purification.

HA.note: From Influenza Hemagglutinin; widely used for detection.

3xHA.note: Tandem tag for higher affinity detection.

Myc.note: From human c-Myc. WARNING: Antibody binding (e.g., 9E10 clone) can be context-dependent.

V5.note: From P and V proteins of Simian Virus 5.

T7.note: Leader sequence from T7 bacteriophage major capsid protein.

S-tag.note: Binds to S-protein (derived from RNase A).

Strep-II.note: Binds with high affinity to Strep-Tactin resin.

Twin-Strep.note: Tandem tag for enhanced binding to Strep-Tactin.

ALFA-tag.note: Small, stable alpha-helical tag for capture and detection.

AviTag.note: Site for specific in vivo or in vitro biotinylation by BirA ligase.

Calmodulin-Binding.note: Ca2+-dependent binding to Calmodulin resin; allows for gentle elution with EGTA.

Rho1D4.note: C-terminal tag for membrane protein purification.

VSV-G.note: Epitope from Vesicular Stomatitis Virus Glycoprotein.

SpyTag.note: Forms a spontaneous, covalent isopeptide bond with its SpyCatcher protein partner.

SnoopTag.note: Forms a covalent bond with its SnoopCatcher partner; orthogonal to SpyTag.

Spot-Tag.note: Binds Spot-Nanobody with high affinity for detection and IP.

HiBiT.note: Luminescent tag; reconstitutes NanoLuciferase with the LgBiT protein fragment.

TEV site.note: Tobacco Etch Virus protease site. Cleavage between Q and G/S.

Thrombin site.note: Common recognition site; cleaves after R. Can have off-target effects.

HRV 3C / PreScission.note: Human Rhinovirus 3C protease. Cleavage between Q and G.

Factor Xa site.note: Cleavage after R. Can have off-target effects.

RGD motif.note: Integrin-binding motif involved in cell adhesion.
